rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THE ELVES OF SCEAFYA MAY ALL BE FEMALE]
rows.current: Bossu: [斯凯菲亚的精灵虽说全是雌性，却并非全都长生不死。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [BUT THEY AREN'T ALL IMMORTAL.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [AS THEY CAN BREED WITH ANY MALE OF ANY SPECIES]
rows.current: Bossu: [她们能与任何物种的雄性繁衍后代，因此逐渐具有了越来越多会衰老死亡的生物特征。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THEY'VE TAKEN ON MORE AND MORE MORTAL CHARACTERISTICS]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [WAIT, SO THAT MEANS SOME OF THEM *ARE* IMMORTAL?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [等等，也就是说，她们当中有些*是*长生不死的？]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [INDEED, AS FAR AS WE CAN TELL.]
rows.current: Bossu: [没错，至少据我们目前所知是这样。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [ANY ELF THAT IS OUT IN THE OPEN AND ENGAGING IN COMBAT]
rows.current: Bossu: [任何一个在开阔处并且正在交战的精灵，无疑会是个年幼者。顶多一百岁。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [WILL NO DOUBT BE A YOUNGSTER. A HUNDRED YEARS OLD AT MOST.]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [THAT'S... WOW...]
rows.current: Yiffany: [这……哇……]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [DON'T GIVE IN TO AWE. YOU'LL NEED TO BE ON YOUR TOES]
rows.current: Bossu: [别光顾着惊叹。要挡住那些年轻精灵的攻击，你得时刻保持警惕。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [IN ORDER TO REPEL THE YOUNG ELVES' ATTACKS.]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [RIGHT, GOTTA FOCUS.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [对，得专注。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [JEEZ! BOSSU, WHAT'S UP WITH THESE RED FURRED FERALS?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [天啊！波苏，这些红毛野狗是怎么回事？]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [FEISTY FELLAS, AREN'T THEY? THEY'RE CALLED "BARKERS".]
rows.current: Bossu: [个个都带劲儿，是吧？他们叫「吠犬」。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [LOOKS LIKE YOU'VE ARRIVED DURING BREEDING SEASON]
rows.current: Bossu: [看样子你正好赶上了它们的繁殖季，而且它们好像还看上你了！]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [AND THEY SEEM TO HAVE AN EYE FOR YOU, TOO!]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [THE WAY THEY JUMP AT ME MAKES THEM SEEM MORE LIKELY TO]
rows.current: Yiffai: [它们这样往我身上扑，倒更像是要把我撞倒，而不是把我弄上-]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [KNOCK ME DOWN INSTEAD OF KNOCK ME U-]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [REGARDLESS, DODGING THEM SHOULDN'T POSE A PROBLEM]
rows.current: Bossu: [不过，对你这样的天才来说，躲开它们应该不成问题，对吧？]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [FOR A PRODIGY LIKE YOU, CORRECT?]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [CORRECT SIR! IT'S JUST A SIMPLE MATTER OF TIMING!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [没错，长官！这不过是时机问题！]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [IN FACT, I'VE EVEN NOTED THAT THEY GROWL BEFORE A LEAP]
rows.current: Yiffai: [事实上，我还记录过它们起跳前会低吼]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [SHARP EYE, KEEP UP THE GOOD WORK.]
rows.current: Bossu: [眼力不错，继续保持。]

rows.source: [JEEZ! BOSSU, WHAT'S UP WITH THESE RED FURRED FERALS?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [天啊！波苏，这些红毛野狗是怎么回事？]

rows.source: [FEISTY FELLAS, AREN'T THEY? THEY'RE CALLED "BARKERS".]
rows.current: Bossu: [个个都带劲儿，是吧？他们叫「吠犬」。]

rows.source: [THEY'RE AN AGGRESS- IVE BREED THAT MAY HAVE MISTAKEN YOU]
rows.current: Bossu: [它们是个好斗的种类，可能把你错认成了]

rows.source: [FOR ONE OF THEIR OWN.]
rows.current: Bossu: [它们的同类。]

rows.source: [SO THEY COULD BE TRYING TO MAKE SURE YOU KNOW YOUR PLACE]
rows.current: Bossu: [所以它们可能是在让你认清自己的地位。]

rows.source: [REGARDLESS, DODGING THEM SHOULDN'T POSE A PROBLEM]
rows.current: Bossu: [不过，对你这样的天才来说，躲开它们应该不成问题，对吧？]

rows.source: [FOR A PRODIGY LIKE YOU, CORRECT?]
[CORRECT SIR! IT'S JUST A SIMPLE MATTER OF TIMING!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [没错，长官！这不过是时机问题！]

rows.source: [IN FACT, I'VE EVEN NOTED THAT THEY GROWL BEFORE A LEAP]
rows.current: Yiffai: [事实上，我还记录过它们起跳前会低吼]

rows.source: [SHARP EYE, KEEP UP THE GOOD WORK.]
rows.current: Bossu: [眼力不错，继续保持。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [AHH, YOU'VE RUN INTO AN OLD FRIEND, HAVE YOU?]
rows.current: Bossu: [哎呀，你这是碰上老朋友了，对吧？]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [THERE'S NO WAY... I THOUGHT I WAS DONE WITH THIS GUY!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [不可能……我还以为已经摆脱这家伙了！]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [YOU SAY "THIS GUY" BUT JUDGING BY THAT BIGBOLD'S POWER]
rows.current: Bossu: [你说「这家伙」，可看那只大壮兽的力量，那一定是这个物种里不同的个体。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [IT MUST BE A DIFFE- RENT MEMBER OF THE SPECIES.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [IT'S QUITE RARE TO SEE THEM THIS CLOSE TO THE SURFACE.]
rows.current: Bossu: [在离地表这么近的地方见到它们，相当罕见。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [RARE? I RAN INTO ONE PRETTY SOON AFTER LANDING...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [很少？我刚降落不久就撞见一只……]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [SOME OF THE TREMORS MUST'VE DISRUPTED A NEST OF 'EM!]
rows.current: Mauser: [肯定是那些震动把它们的巢给震坏了！]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [AS BIG AND BULKY AS THEY ARE, IF ONE OF THEIR ROUTES]
rows.current: Mauser: [它们个头又大又笨重，要是哪条路线被切断，能选的路就不如你多了。]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [GETS CUT OFF, THEY DON'T HAVE AS MANY OPTIONS AS YOU DO.]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [T-TRUE... I JUST THOUGHT THEY WERE LOOKING FOR A FIGHT]
rows.current: Yiffai: [说、说得也是……我还以为它们就是想打架]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [JUST BE CAREFUL WITH THEM, YIFFAI.]
rows.current: Bossu: [对它们还是小心点，伊吠。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [AS TEMPTING AS IT MAY BE TO CAPTURE ONE FOR STUDYING]
rows.current: Bossu: [抓一只回去研究虽然很诱人，可你在这么深处遇到的，肯定比之前追捕过的那只大壮兽还强。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [ANY YOU FIND THIS DEEP DOWN ARE SURE TO BE EVEN STRONGER]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THAN THE BIGBOLD YOU CHASED DOWN BEFORE.]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [EEYUCK, WASN'T EXPECTING SOMETHING LIKE THAT HERE...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [呕，没料到这儿会有那种东西……]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THAT APPEARS TO HAVE BEEN A BLOCKER.]
rows.current: Bossu: [那看来是一只Blocker。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [IT'S A STRANGE ANOMALY THAT EMERGES FROM RUINS]
rows.current: Bossu: [它是一种会从废墟中现身的奇异异常体，而且看来对大多数物理攻击都免疫。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [AND SEEMS TO BE IMPERVIOUS TO MOST PHYSICAL ATTACKS.]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: ["PHYSICAL" ATTACKS? AS OPPOSED TO...?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [“物理”攻击？那相对的是什么攻击……？]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [SOME REPORTS FROM PREVIOUS AGENTS MENTIONED THAT]
rows.current: Bossu: [之前有些特工的报告提到过，Blocker对“精神”攻击较为脆弱。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [BLOCKERS WERE VUL- NERABLE TO "PSYCHICAL" ATTACKS]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [WE DISMISSED THOSE REPORTS AS UNRELIABLE, BUT...]
rows.current: Bossu: [我们当时觉得这些报告不可靠，没有采信，不过……]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [I'VE NEVER SEEN GLOWING TENTACLES SPROUTING BEFORE]
rows.current: Yiffai: [我从没见过会发光的触须冒出来，所以我差不多什么都能信了……]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [SO I'M ALMOST READY TO BELIEVE ANYTHING...]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [OKAY, THAT THING WAS GROSS. WHAT THE HECK WAS IT?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [好吧，那东西真恶心。那到底是什么玩意儿？]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THAT APPEARS TO HAVE BEEN A BLOCKER.]
rows.current: Bossu: [那看来是一只Blocker。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: ["PHYSICAL" ATTACKS? WHAT OTHER KIND OF ATTACKS ARE THERE?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [“物理”攻击？还有别的攻击方式吗？]

rows.source: [SOME REPORTS FROM PREVIOUS AGENTS MENTIONED THAT]
rows.current: Bossu: [之前有些特工的报告提到过，Blocker对“精神”攻击较为脆弱]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [WE DISMISSED THOSE REPORTS AS UNRELIABLE, BUT...]
rows.current: Bossu: [我们当时把这些报告当作不可靠的给驳回了，但是……]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [AFTER SEEING THIS THING IN PERSON]
rows.current: Yiffany: [不过，在亲眼见过这东西之后，我已经不确定到底*什么*还算可靠了……]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [I'M NOT SURE WHAT EVEN *IS* RELIABLE ANYMORE...]
[W-WHAT'S UP WITH THESE ROBO BUGS THAT KEEP COMING AT ME?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [这、这些一直朝我冲过来的机器虫是怎么回事？]

rows.source: [YOU'D THINK THEY'D RUN OUT MATERIALS BY NOW!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [按理说它们的材料早该用光了吧！]

rows.source: [MUCH OF THE ROBOTIC MATERIAL IN THAT OLD SPACE STATION]
rows.current: Bossu: [那座旧太空站里的许多机械装置，都配有纳米机械回收系统。]

rows.source: [ARE BUILT WITH NANOMECHANICAL RECYCLING SYSTEMS.]
[NA-NO-MY-HUH?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [纳——诺——什么玩意儿？]

rows.source: [BASICALLY THEY'RE DESIGNED TO SELF REPAIR ENDLESSLY.]
rows.current: Bossu: [简单说，它们被设计成能无限自我修复。]

rows.source: [IT USED TO BE A POPULAR LOW- MAINTENANCE DESIGN]
rows.current: Bossu: [这种低维护设计以前很受欢迎，直到后来人们发现，等它们过时以后，也没办法把它们拆开。]

rows.source: [UNTIL IT WAS REALIZED THAT THEY COULDN'T BE TAKEN]
[APART WHEN THEY BECAME OBSOLETE.]
[THEY REPAIR THEM- SELVES FASTER THAN WE CAN BREAK EM!]
rows.current: Bossu: [它们自我修复的速度比我们破坏的还快！]

rows.source: [AHH, SO THAT'S WHY I'VE NEVER SEEN THESE KIND OF]
rows.current: Yiffany: [啊，难怪我从小到大都没见过这种机器人……]

rows.source: [ROBOTS WHILE GROWING UP...]
[...NEATO!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [……真酷！]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THERE ARE REPORTS THAT A "HOPPER" THAT ABSORBS ENOUGH]
rows.current: Bossu: [有报道称，一只「跳跃者」只要吸收了足够的灵能，就会变成「牛蛙」，能从远处朝目标喷吐泡泡，甚至还能用新长出来的修长舌头造成伤害。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [PSYCHIC ENERGY WILL TURN INTO A "BULLFROG"]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [CAPABLE OF SHOOTING BUBBLES AT TARGETS FROM AFAR OR EVEN]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [DEALING DAMAGE WITH THEIR NEW, ELONGATED TONGUE.]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [SOUNDS TRICKY...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [听着挺棘手……]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [FORTUNATELY WATER IS SCARCE IN THAT SECTOR OF SCEAFYA]
rows.current: Bossu: [幸运的是，斯凯菲亚那片区域缺水，否则你还得提防它们连你一起伏击呢！]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [OR YOU'D HAVE TO WORRY ABOUT THEM AMBUSHING YOU TOO!]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THOSE MACHINES BUMPING UP AND DOWN INCESSANTLY]
rows.current: Bossu: [那些不停上下弹跳的机器似乎是某种巡逻机器人，目前出了故障。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [ARE SOME SORT OF PATROL DROIDS THAT ARE CURRENTLY]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [MALFUNCTIONING.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THEY SHOULDN'T POSE A THREAT, JUST TRY TO AVOID THEM.]
rows.current: Bossu: [它们应该构不成威胁，尽量避开就好。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [BOSSU, THERE ARE SOME TURRETS HERE THAT ARE SIMILAR TO]
rows.current: Yiffany: [波苏，这里的这些炮塔，跟我们在家乡训练时用的那种炮塔很像！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [THE TURRETS WE USED FOR TRAINING BACK HOME!]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THAT MODEL OF TURRET HAS BEEN STANDARD ISSUE FOR]
rows.current: Bossu: [那种型号的炮塔作为制式装备，已经用了两个世纪左右吧。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THE LAST COUPLE OF CENTURIES OR SO.]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [WOAH, YOU'RE KIDDING!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [哇，你是在开玩笑吧！]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [NOBODY'S REALLY TAKEN ON THE JOB OF REPLACING THOSE OLD]
rows.current: Bossu: [其实并没有人真的接下更换那些老旧自卫武器的活儿。它们几乎从来不会坏，你也看到了！]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [SELF DEFENSE WEAPONS. THEY ALMOST NEVER BREAK DOWN,]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [AS YOU CAN SEE!]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [THANKFULLY A FEW WHACKS SEEMS TO STOP THEM STILL...]
rows.current: Yiffany: [还好敲上几下好像还能让它们停下来……]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [HEY BOSSU? THE TURRETS HERE SEEM KINDA FAMILIAR.]
rows.current: Yiffai: [嘿，波苏？这里的炮塔好像有点眼熟。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [DIDN'T WE USE SOMETHING SIMILAR, BACK IN... UMM...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [我们是不是也用过类似的，在……嗯……]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [BACK IN TRAINING, THAT'S RIGHT YIFFAI.]
rows.current: Bossu: [在训练的时候，没错，伊吠。]

rows.source: [THAT MODEL OF TURRET HAS BEEN STANDARD ISSUE FOR]
rows.current: Bossu: [那种型号的炮塔作为制式装备，已经用了两个世纪左右吧。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THE LAST COUPLE OF CENTURIES OR SO.]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [A COUPLE OF CENTURIES?? NO WAY!!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [两个世纪？？不可能吧！！]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [YES WAY. NOBODY'S BOTHERED TRYING TO REPLACE THOSE OLD]
rows.current: Bossu: [当然有可能。没人费心去换那些老旧的自卫武器。它们几乎从来不会坏，你也看到了！]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [THEY BREAK DOWN PRETTY EASILY IF I HIT THEM ENOUGH...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [只要我多敲几下，它们坏得还挺容易……]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [BOSSU, ARE THERE CANNONS STRONGER OR AM I WEAKER?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [波苏，是这些炮变强了，还是我变弱了？]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THESE CANNONS SEEM TO HAVE GONE A WHILE WITHOUT]
rows.current: Bossu: [这些加农炮似乎已经有一段时间不需要自行修复了。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [NEEDING TO BE SELF- REPAIRED.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [CONSEQUENTLY THEY SEEM TO BE FIRING AT HIGHER POWER.]

rows.current: Bossu: [那些装在天花板上的炮台全都失控了，大概是因为电力系统受损。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [PROBABLY DUE TO ALL THE ELECTRICAL SYSTEM DAMAGE]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [OH SO THEY AREN'T SUPPOSED TO BE SPINNING AROUND AND]
rows.current: Yiffany: [哦，所以它们本来不该这样乱转，还那样胡乱扫射吗？]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [SHOOTING INDISCRIMINATELY LIKE THAT?]

rows.source: [DEFINITELY NOT. TRY NOT TO STAY UNDER THEM FOR TOO LONG.]
rows.current: Bossu: [绝对不是。尽量别在它们底下待太久。]
